Content: A landscape architect is designing a long stone pathway for a community garden. The blueprints specify that the total length of the pathway must be exactly `text(45 yards)`. The contractor needs to order the stone borders in `text(feet)`.
What is the length of the pathway, in feet? (`text(1 yard)=text(3 feet)`)

An industrial bakery receives a bulk shipment of organic flour weighing exactly `text(325 pounds)` to prepare for a weekend baking cycle. The automated mixing machines are programmed to process ingredients measured in `text(ounces)`.
What is the total weight of the flour shipment, in `text(ounces)`? (`text(1 pound)=text(16 ounces)`)

An engineering team is measuring the runtime duration of a new high-speed electric train on a closed test track. The train completes its continuous high-velocity trials after running for exactly `text(240 minutes)`. The lead engineer needs to record this testing duration in `text(hours)` for the final compliance report.
What was the duration of the train trials, in `text(hours)`? (`text(1 hour)=text(60 minutes)`)

A maritime logistics firm loads shipping containers onto a cargo vessel. The maximum allowable payload weight for a specific reinforced storage slot on the deck is `text(14 tons)`. The crane operator's digital scale displays cargo weight in `text(pounds)`.
What is the maximum payload weight of the storage slot, in `text(pounds)`? (`text(1 ton)=text(2,000 pounds)`)

A city's athletic committee maps out the running route for an upcoming charity marathon. The total distance of the main road segment of the course is measured at `text(32,500 meters)`. For the race website, the committee needs to display this distance in `text(kilometers)`.
What is the distance of the road segment, in `text(kilometers)`? (`text(1 kilometer)=text(1,000 meters)`)

A landscape architect is designing a long stone pathway for a community park. The blueprints specify that the total length of the pathway must be exactly `text(20 yards)`. The contractor needs to order the stone borders, which are sold in dimensions measured in `text(inches)`.
What is the total length of the pathway, in `text(inches)`? (`text(1 yard)=text(3 feet)`; `text(1 foot)=text(12 inches)`)

An industrial bakery receives a bulk container of organic honey to prepare for a weekend baking cycle. The container holds exactly `text(6 gallons)` of honey. The automated mixing machines are programmed to process ingredients measured in `text(fluid ounces)`.
What is the total volume of the honey container, in `text(fluid ounces)`? (`text(1 gallon)=text(4 quarts)`; `text(1 quart)=text(32 fluid ounces)`)

An aerospace engineering team is measuring the runtime duration of an automated experiment on a satellite. The mission clock records that the experiment ran continuously for exactly `text(3 days)`. To input the data into a high-speed physics modeling program, the team needs to record this duration in `text(minutes)`.
What was the duration of the experiment, in `text(minutes)`? (`text(1 day)=text(24 hours)`; `text(1 hour)=text(60 minutes)`)

A maritime logistics firm weighs a massive shipment of hardware parts on a digital freight scale. The scale displays the total cargo weight as exactly `text(384,000 ounces)`. The shipyard coordinator needs to log this weight in `text(tons)` on a shipping manifest.
What is the total weight of the cargo, in `text(tons)`? (`text(16 ounces)=text(1 pound)`; `text(2,000 pounds)=text(1 ton)`)

A city's athletic committee maps out a custom running loop for a charity race. The event tracker records the total distance of the course as exactly `text(1,800,000 centimeters)`. For the event's promotional banners, the committee needs to display this distance in kilometers.
What is the total distance of the course, in `text(kilometers)`? (`text(100 centimeters)=text(1 meter)`; `text(1,000 meters)=text(1 kilometer)`)
